blurb: Guests join fishing trips targeting species like Bluefin Tuna, Mahi, Albies, Bonito, and Giant Sea Bass, or enjoy party cruises. Trips vary in duration from 3 hours to 18-20 hours and operate offshore. Advance prepaid reservations are required for some trips.
extraNote: Trips usually run in light rain and moderate weather · Trips may be canceled for severe or unsafe weather or sea conditions · If operator cancels, guests may reschedule, get credit, or full refund · Offshore trips are non-refundable unless canceled by operator for weather · 20% gratuity added automatically on party cruises
